title: Commerce Technical Reference
readerIntent: Audit the composed commerce contract without merging capability ownership.
owner: Storefront, Store, Product, Pricing, Inventory, Units, workflow, publishing, cache, and search owners
summary: Commerce integration passes stable identities and verified context between modules; no module writes another capability's models directly.

sections.heading: Contract checklist
items: Tenant, enterprise, Site, Store, country, channel, locale, currency, catalog, customer/segment, product/variant, unit, and time context.
Stable cross-module references and audience-bound Storefront handle.
Independent authorization, validation, persistence, cache, search, version, workflow, and publishing authority.
Staged/Online topology, target transport, derived refresh, audit, reconciliation, rollback, and compensation.
Positive, negative, boundary, contract, integration, cross-tenant, performance, failure, security, and regression tests.
